title: National Identity, Vital Records & Civic Services
description: The sequential citizen roadmap to obtain your Ghana Card, register vital birth and death certificates, register on the national voters register, enroll in NHIS, and access unified payments on Ghana.gov.

steps.title: Register Birth or Death Records with BDR
steps.why: The Registration of Births and Deaths Act mandates official registration to secure biometric certified birth certificates, the foundational proof of Ghanaian citizenship.
steps.do_this_when: Within the statutory window following a birth or when replacing lost certificates.

options.label: Birth Registration Portal
options.notes: Application for birth certification and search verification.

options.label: Death Registration Form & Processing
options.notes: Official death registry and burial permit processing.

steps.title: Enroll for Biometric National ID (Ghana Card)
steps.why: The National Identity Register Act mandates the Ghana Card as the exclusive national ID for banking, SIM registration, taxation, passport issuance, and civil services.
steps.do_this_when: At any NIA district or regional registration center.

options.label: Ghana Card Application Forms & Requirements
options.notes: Form One download and district registration guidelines.

options.label: Ghana Card Replacement Request Service
options.notes: Replace lost, damaged, or stolen national identity cards.

options.label: Ghana Card Data Update & Correction Service
options.notes: Correct spelling errors, marital name changes, or address updates.

steps.title: Enroll in National Health Insurance Scheme (NHIS)
steps.why: Provides subsidised healthcare and essential drug access at accredited hospitals, polyclinics, and pharmacies across all Ghanaian regions.
steps.do_this_when: At any age; link directly to your Ghana Card for seamless membership verification.

options.label: NHIS Membership Registration & Mobile Renewal
options.notes: Online membership guide and shortcode renewal portal.

steps.title: Register on the National Voters Register (EC)
steps.why: Article 42 of the 1992 Constitution empowers all eligible citizens aged 18 and above of sound mind to be registered on the electoral roll to vote in national elections.
steps.do_this_when: During designated Electoral Commission limited registration exercises.

options.label: Electoral Commission Voter Registration Form 1
options.notes: Official Form 1A application for registration on the national voters register.

steps.title: Activate Ghana.gov Single Sign-On Services Portal
steps.why: Unified digital service and payment platform for all ministries, departments, and agencies in Ghana, allowing single sign-on access to government services.
steps.do_this_when: For paying government statutory fees, assembly permits, or verifying documents.

options.label: Ghana.gov Government Services & Payments Portal
options.notes: Unified digital portal for government e-services and cashless payments.
